parameters.help_en: The start time for the data query. Format: 2023-01-01 00:00:00
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the data query. Format: 2023-02-01 23:59:59
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The statistical dimension. Valid values:
productCode: aggregates data by cloud service.
region: aggregates data by region.
subUid: aggregates data by RAM user.

If this parameter is not specified, data is aggregated by Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 统计维度，productCode：按云产品统计；region：按区域维度统计；subUid按RAM子用户统计，不传按主账号维度统计
parameters.name: group

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud account IDs for which you want to query data. Specify this parameter after you enable the multi-account management feature
parameters.help_zh: 需要查询数据的主账号id的list，开通多账号管理后传入
parameters.name: uids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return the carbon emission details of multiple accounts. Specify this parameter after you enable the multi-account management feature. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 0. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes
parameters.help_zh: 是否统计多账号的碳排放明细，开通多账号管理可后传入，不传默认否，0：否，1：是
parameters.name: filter_rd_account

parameters.help_en: The number of top entries to return after sorting the results by value in descending order. If this parameter is not specified, all data is returned
parameters.help_zh: 按照返回值的数据值倒序排序后，只返回前TopNum条数据，不传默认返回全部数据
parameters.name: top_num

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the code as the identifier in the response. If this parameter is not specified, the code is used by default. Valid values:
0: does not use the code.
1: uses the code.

For example, when the response contains carbon emissions aggregated by cloud service, the identifier for Elastic Compute Service is "ecs" if this parameter is set to 0, and "弹性计算ECS" if this parameter is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
返回值是否使用code作为标识，不传默认使用code，0：不使用，1：使用。
例如返回值为按照云产品维度汇总碳排放时，云服务器的标识在传0时为“ecs”，传1时为“弹性计算ECS”
parameters.name: use_code

QuotaValue.description_en: The carbon emissions calculated based on the requested time range. Unit: kgCO₂e
QuotaValue.description_zh: 根据请求时间统计的碳排放量，单位kgCO₂e

Region.description_en: The region of the cloud service

StatisticsDate.description_en: The statistics date, in millisecond-level timestamp

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
